text: Select: compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), compound name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to docs via compound_records (molregno = compound_records.molregno AND compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id); molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (molregno = compound_structures.molregno). Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197'. Sort: chembl_id ascending.
